synthesizer_contract.inputs: Only the five separately frozen M25 role RAW files listed in frozen_role_inputs.
synthesizer_contract.shared_context_non_isolation_risk: The producers and synthesizer were role-bound sequential passes in one coordinated model context. Blob freezing prevents later rewriting but does not create independent-agent isolation.
synthesizer_contract.reconciliation_rule: Contradictions are resolved by evidence scope, authority and readback limitations, not majority.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Innovation selects NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED while Architecture, Authority and Coverage select VERIFY_FIRST.
reconciliation.resolution: The scopes differ. Innovation rejects runtime/product repair on P0; the other roles request evidence-only verification of currentness, authority and totality. These are compatible: no runtime action, but verify before any current-state closure.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: Current equivalence and material consumer coverage remain unknown.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Performance selects NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE while the proposed integrated state is VERIFY_FIRST.
reconciliation.resolution: VERIFY_FIRST is the procedural next state, not a performance verdict. The performance conclusion remains NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE until an intervention boundary, complete clocks and matched workload cohort exist.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: No improvement or regression magnitude is inferred from positive-only or unmatched medians.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: All 38 caller names and 21 trigger names still resolve, yet Architecture reports 22 hash mismatches and six absent lexical edge names.
reconciliation.resolution: Name/OID existence tests continuity only; it does not establish canonical body-hash equality, route equivalence or runtime invocation. Historical hash serialization is also unknown.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: The six lexical changes may be replacement, dynamic resolution, rename or removal.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Receipt 38 is VERIFIED/PASS, while the case still cannot close.
reconciliation.resolution: Receipt 38 authoritatively verifies historical SOAK_OBSERVATION_HISTORY_V2 criteria. It does not attest a causal performance improvement, post-cut inventory totality, current route equivalence or material actor independence.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: Historical soak adequacy is preserved; current and performance claims remain separate.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Curator and Validator identity/component fields differ, but Authority withholds an independence conclusion.
reconciliation.resolution: Distinct stored labels/components are supporting evidence, not proof of separate effective principals, inputs, execution paths or non-collusion.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: Material independence requires canonical execution provenance.

reconciliation.apparent_conflict: Bounded current complements contain 53 name-pattern objects and 18 lexical candidates outside P0, but Coverage does not call them missing consumers.
reconciliation.resolution: These searches identify candidates only. Pattern/lexical occurrence cannot prove runtime materiality or define the total universe; P0 also includes eight names outside the selected pattern.
reconciliation.preserved_uncertainty: The authoritative current universe and exclusion rules are not yet attested.

integrated_findings.claim: P0 supports no demonstrated runtime/product defect: historical soak receipt 38 is verified and its negative criteria are zero.
P0 does not support a causal claim of integral performance improvement or regression.
Post-cut object/name continuity is strong for the frozen callers/triggers, but present definition/route equivalence and total consumer coverage are not certified.
The read-only boundary is intentional and must not be widened; permission denial is not functional failure.
Nominal identity/component separation is observed, but material Curator/Validator independence is not attested.
Existing manifest/context/cache surfaces argue for reuse-first verification and against creating a new runtime mechanism without a proven gap.

E.rationale: No runtime repair is supported by P0, but present-state closure is also unsupported. A bounded evidence-only verification can discriminate current topology/coverage/authority risks; performance remains explicitly NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE until a matched cohort exists.
E.no_action_scope: No production, runtime, grant, variant-deletion or optimization action.
verification_scope: Canonical current object/consumer/trigger manifest with documented hash serialization, active-entry mapping, lifecycle and exclusions.
Canonical authority/ledger linkage and material Curator/Validator independence readback.
Matched performance comparison with explicit intervention boundary, equivalent workload and complete clocks.
potential_falsifiers: Authoritative current manifest proves body/route/entry equivalence and complete material consumer coverage.
Canonical provenance proves material independence and valid current verification without privilege widening.
Matched complete performance evidence establishes or rejects a material change.

reversal_criteria.to_REPAIR_REQUIRED: A governed verification demonstrates a material active defect with an attributable minimal target.
reversal_criteria.to_NO_ACTION_SUPPORTED: All currentness, coverage, authority and matched-performance unknowns close without a material defect.
reversal_criteria.to_NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE: The three verification products cannot be obtained safely or remain underpowered/ambiguous.

causal_model.integrated_hypothesis: The immediate systemic risk is evidence-scope collapse: valid historical soak evidence, static inventory, nominal identities and descriptive timings can be merged into an unsupported claim of current, causal and independent improvement.
causal_chain: potential hidden consumer, route or independence risk

A current architecture/coverage defect exists outside P0.
A real performance change exists but available cohorts are incomparable.
Duplicate/context variants are intentional compatibility surfaces.
